transcript.final_yaml:
collection: 00 - FSR Studio
playbooks:
- name: 'FortiAIGate: Student Prompt Investigation and Response'
  trigger: start
  is_active: true
  parameters:
  - student_key
  steps:
  - type: start
    name: Start
    button_label: FortiAIGate student investigation
    next: Find related student alerts
    module: alerts
  - type: find_record
    name: Find related student alerts
    module: alerts
    filters:
    - field: name
      operator: contains
      value: "{{ vars.input.params.student_key }}"
    limit: 100
    next: Summarize related alerts
  - type: set_variable
    name: Summarize related alerts
    vars:
      related_count: "{{ vars.steps.Find_related_student_alerts | length }}"
    next: Analyst approves key suspension
  - type: manual_input
    name: Analyst approves key suspension
    message: "Suspend the student API key? No containment connector is configured on this instance, so approval records the decision only."
    options:
    - option: Suspend
      primary: true
    - option: Keep
    - option: Escalate
    next: Record analyst verdict
  - type: update_record
    name: Record analyst verdict
    module: alerts
    record: "{{ vars.input.records[0]['@id'] }}"
    fields:
      aIVerdict: Suspicious
transcript.summary: Manual playbook on the alerts module. It finds related alerts for a student API key, asks the analyst to choose Suspend, Keep or Escalate, and writes the analyst verdict to the alert. Key suspension is an approval-only record: no containment connector is configured on this instance, so nothing is suspended automatically.
